## 5. One Non-Obvious Thing I Noticed

**The halt that should have cleared hasn't — and the daily rebalance may be working against itself.**

WOLF's circuit breaker message, frozen from 2026-05-13, cites PLTR at 47.6% concentration. Current PLTR is ~8.2% of portfolio — nearly compliant with the 8% single-name cap. Yet `halt_new_entries` remains true 35 days later. 

Meanwhile today's 3 rebalancing trades all sold the *wrong positions for mandate compliance*: XLE (−5 shares), MDT (−2), JPM (−1). None of these are the overweight names that triggered the halt (PLTR, NVDA, MSFT, TSLA). The mandate's vault-floor requirement (60–70% in stable assets) demands buying more SHV/VOO — but with negative cash (−$380), new buys can't fire while `halt_new_entries = true`. This is a catch-22: the halt prevents buying vault assets, and buying vault assets is what would bring the portfolio into compliance and clear the halt. The auto-rebalance is trimming the wrong positions (the ones below threshold), and the loop has no path to resolution. The mandate enforcement gate is self-blocking.
